newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end mixed despite higher index.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end mixed despite higher index.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index closed one percent higher, pulled up by bank and interest-sensitive issues, but broader market ended mixed since golds depressed by weaker bullion prices.
Toronto's key stock index soared to close more than one percent higher on Monday but the broader market ended mixed as gold issue slipped on weaker bullion prices.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index jumped 69.47 points, or 1.1 percent, to 6144.25. Trading was moderate at 89.7 million shares worth C$1.71 million.
Despite broad gains, declining issues still outnumbered advances 488 to 465 while 286 traded unchanged.
"Quite a blue chip rally," remarked portfolio manager Josef Schachter, head of Schachter Asset Management.
